| Date (2023) | Holiday | Long‑Weekend? | Notes |
|-------------|---------|---------------|-------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island) | ✅ | Monday – creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri 17‑Mon 20) |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | ✅ | Friday – creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri 7‑Mon 10) |
| **Apr 10** | Easter Monday | ✅ | Monday – creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri 7‑Mon 10) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | ✅ | Monday – creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri 19‑Mon 22) |
| **Aug 7** | Civic Holiday (Ontario, British Columbia, etc.) | ✅ | Monday – creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri 4‑Mon 7) |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | ✅ | Monday – creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri 1‑Mon 4) |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | ✅ | Monday – creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri 6‑Mon 9) |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | ✅ | Monday – creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri 8‑Mon 11) |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | ✅ | Monday – creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri 22‑Mon 25) |

```json
  {"date":"2023-11-11","holiday":"Remembrance Day","longWeekend":true},

]
```

Feel free to copy the table or JSON into your app. If you need additional province‑specific holidays or want to adjust for holidays that fall on weekends (e.g., New Year’s Day on Sunday, Canada Day on Saturday), just let me know!
